reasoning: The stated constraint forbids each new bishop from attacking any pre-placed piece and other new bishops. A diagonal containing a pre-placed piece is unusable: its nearest occupant would always be attacked, regardless of pieces beyond it. Every remaining empty cell joins its two unobstructed diagonals; two bishops conflict exactly when these edges share a diagonal. Maximum bipartite matching therefore gives the optimum. Existing pieces attacking one another are irrelevant as specified; no geometry image or hidden case is needed.
